title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING ADDITIONAL EMPLOYEES OF THE PHILIPPINE CIVIL SERVICE BOARD, AND APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF EIGHT HUNDRED DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, FOR THE PAYMENT OF SALARIES OF SUCH EMPLOYEES FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE FISCAL YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.

title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép tuyển thêm nhân viên cho Hội đồng Dịch vụ Dân sự Philippines và cấp khoản tiền tám trăm đô la Mỹ để trả lương cho những nhân viên này trong phần còn lại của năm tài chính 1903
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้มีพนักงานเพิ่มเติมของคณะกรรมการบริการพลเรือนฟิลิปปินส์ และจัดสรรงบประมาณจำนวนแปดร้อยดอลลาร์สหรัฐเพื่อจ่ายเงินเดือนพนักงานดังกล่าวสำหรับส่วนที่เหลือของปีงบประมาณ พ.ศ. 2446
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan tambahan pegawai Dewan Layanan Sipil Filipina serta mengalokasikan delapan ratus dolar Amerika Serikat untuk pembayaran gaji pegawai tersebut selama sisa tahun fiskal 1903
title.ms: Akta mengiktiraf pekerja tambahan Jawatankuasa Perkhidmatan Awam Filipina dan mengperuntukkan lapan ratus dolar Amerika Syarikat untuk bayaran gaji pekerja tersebut bagi baki tahun kewangan 1903

text.en:
There may be employed by the Philippine Civil Service Board two examiners, class seven, in
addition to the force heretofore authorized.

The sum of eight hundred dollars, in money of the United States, or its equivalent in local
currency at the authorized rate of exchange, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated,
out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for salaries and wages. Philippine Civil
Service Board, nineteen hundred and three, in addition to the amount appropriated under Act Numbered Five
hundred and ninety-five for such purposes.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 4, 1903.
